description: Source code for DeepInfraHandler class implementing API interactions with DeepInfra and OpenAI models, including message creation, model fetching, and usage metrics processing.

classes.name: DeepInfraHandler
classes.description: A class extending RouterProvider to handle API requests to DeepInfra, including model fetching, message creation, and usage tracking.

methods.name: fetchModel
methods.description: Fetches available models from DeepInfra and updates internal model list.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns current model information, including ID and parameters.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a streaming message request to the API, handling model support, tools, and streaming responses.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: processUsageMetrics
methods.description: Processes API usage data to compute token counts and costs.
